mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 3% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 3%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in Real Final Sales of Domestic Product (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances with RSAFS 3-month growth.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 2% YoY signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO YoY < -2%.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and the CPIAUCSL is rising, it signals aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5% and CPIAUCSL is rising.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 300,000 in a month signals strong labor demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases > 300,000.

mechanism_narrative: When Housing Starts (HOUST) decrease by more than 10% YoY and Real GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 2% YoY, it signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where HOUST YoY < -10% and GDPC1 YoY < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 3% signals strong supply-side growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances with INDPRO 3-month growth > 3%.
